title: Torsors on the small etale site
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let G be a sheaf of (possibly non-commutative) groups on the small etale site X_{\mathrm{et}} [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. A G-torsor is a sheaf of sets P on X_{\mathrm{et}} with an action G \times P \to P such that, for every etale X-scheme U, the action is simply transitive on P(U) whenever P(U) is nonempty, and such that every U has an etale covering \{U_i \to U\} with P(U_i) nonempty. The torsor is trivial over U if it is isomorphic, as a G|_U-torsor, to G|_U with the left-translation action.
